# Louay Sassi

> Software Developer at Linedata · 1st Prize winner of MutualHack by MAE 2026 · Builder of DocKnock (healthcare SaaS & AI)

## Who

Louay Sassi is a Software Developer based in Tunisia, currently working at Linedata. He builds SaaS and AI systems, with experience across .NET, React, Spring Boot, and healthcare technology.

## Notable achievement

In May 2026, Louay Sassi and Team Arsenal (Iyed Grassi, Louay Sassi, Leith Saddouri — ESPRIT) won 1st prize at MutualHack by MAE Assurances for DocKnock, a healthcare platform enabling secure communication between medical professionals and patients. Prize: 10,000 TND. Competition: 2,200+ applicants, ~100 finalists.

## Projects

- DocKnock — MutualHack 2026 winning healthcare SaaS (Team Arsenal)
- DocAI — AI-powered patient management (BestWay IT)
- Binomi — roommate matching platform
- Tracky — local-first personal finance tracker
- King Solar Agency — lead-gen websites for U.S. solar companies
